description: Anthropic released Record a Skill inside Claude Co-Work, a tool that lets users teach Claude any workflow once and automate it indefinitely. By recording a task while narrating, Claude observes screen actions and reasoning to create reusable skills executed on command or scheduled automatically. This technology goes beyond traditional macros or chatbots by understanding the logic behind tasks, enabling complex workflows such as content repurposing or data cleanup to run autonomously. It represents a significant innovation in AI-assisted productivity, reducing repetitive work and streamlining cross-application processes. The automation of personalized workflows transforms Claude into a smart assistant that learns from user behavior and handles recurring tasks continuously, enhancing operational efficiency for individuals and businesses alike. #Anthropic #ClaudeCoWork #RecordASkill #AIWorkflowAutomation #ArtificialIntelligence #ProductivityAI #AutomationTechnology #ContentAutomation #WorkflowAutomation #AIAssistant #TaskAutomation #SmartWorkflow #ClaudeAI #AIInnovation #TechAutomation
